name: HyperVault
rootCause: The DeFi protocol HyperVault, built on the Hyperliquid chain, has executed a rug pull, making off with approximately $3.61 million.

descriptions.text: The DeFi protocol HyperVault, built on the Hyperliquid chain, has executed a rug pull, making off with approximately $3.61 million.

On 26 September 2025, the developers of HyperVault executed a rug pull on Hyperliquid L1, draining over $3.6 million in user assets. The project exploited a privileged internal ledger and admin-only control to move funds to Ethereum and obscure the trail using Tornado Cash. There is no evidence of recovery, and all social accounts were deleted immediately after. Privileged admin access and a hidden internal ledger enabled the HyperVault team to withdraw all user funds, exploiting trust and lack of transparency rather than a specific contract bug.
